candidates.title: Capability Gain Is Not Recovery Authority
candidates.title_zh: 能力提升，不是恢复授权
candidates.researchQuestion: 当自我改进带来的能力提升与可恢复性可能分离时，受治理数字员工运行体在允许修改生效前应要求什么证据？
candidates.coreProposition: Capability qualification and recoverability qualification must be independent adoption gates: activation should bind an exact, independently verified recovery bundle for the frozen mutation rather than infer recoverability from forward improvement or the modifying worker’s own account.

sections.heading: Forward Success Can Hide Recovery Failure
sections.heading_zh: 向前成功，也可能掩盖恢复失败

sections.heading: Recovery Is a Relation, Not a Snapshot
sections.heading_zh: 恢复是一种关系，不是一份快照

sections.heading: Freeze the Mutation Before Diagnosing Recovery
sections.heading_zh: 先冻结修改，再诊断恢复

sections.heading: Four Authorities Should Not Collapse into One
sections.heading_zh: 四种权威不能压成一种

sections.heading: Activation Must Bind an Exact Recovery Bundle
sections.heading_zh: 生效必须绑定精确恢复证据包

evidenceClaims.claim: The study reports 197 capability-positive mutations that fail recovery verification among 281 candidates admitted to capability and recovery evaluation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告：281 个进入能力与恢复评估的候选中，有 197 个修改改善了能力目标却未通过恢复验证。

evidenceClaims.claim: At the reported budget, conventional repair recovers 0/197 failures; a deterministic oracle reaches 48/197 under L0 and 191/197 under L1.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 在报告预算下，常规修复对 197 个失败对象的恢复数为 0；确定性预言器在 L0 中达到 48/197，在 L1 中达到 191/197。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study defines recovery over a frozen mutation, pre-state witness, independently derived effect surface, counterfactual states and typed observational equivalence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究把恢复定义为冻结修改、修改前见证、独立推导的影响范围、反事实状态与类型化观察等价之间的关系。

evidenceClaims.claim: The paper reports full-snapshot restoration at 0/300 when legitimate subsequent state must be preserved.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 论文报告：当合法后续状态必须保留时，整份快照恢复为 0/300。

evidenceClaims.claim: Capability success cannot serve as activation evidence for an independently unproved recovery property.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 能力成功不能替尚未独立证明的恢复性质充当生效证据。

evidenceClaims.claim: Activation should bind the exact mutation, witness, effect surface, recovery mechanism, counterfactual set, equivalence contract and verifier result.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 生效应绑定精确修改、见证、影响范围、恢复机制、反事实集合、等价合同与验证结果。

projectRelevance.rationale: The governance boundary stands without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already carries the evidence and governance argument; a separate edition would repeat it without a distinct community angle.

candidates.title: A Restartable Plugin Still Needs External Recovery Truth
candidates.title_zh: 插件可以重启，恢复事实必须留在进程之外
candidates.researchQuestion: 在进程隔离能够支持可信恢复之前，哪些持久状态必须存在于可丢弃插件或工作进程之外？
candidates.coreProposition: Process isolation becomes trustworthy recovery only when session truth, stable effect identity, durable-before-visible settlement, and ownership generations survive outside the failed worker; effects beyond that represented boundary still require independent provider-side evidence.

sections.heading: Isolation Limits Failure but Does Not Reconstruct History
sections.heading_zh: 隔离能限制故障，却不能重建历史

sections.heading: Three Similar Crash States Need Different Decisions
sections.heading_zh: 三个相似崩溃状态，需要不同决定

sections.heading: Put Recovery Truth Outside the Worker
sections.heading_zh: 把恢复事实放到工作进程之外

sections.heading: Durable Before Visible Creates a Replay Boundary
sections.heading_zh: 先持久、后可见，才能形成重放边界

sections.heading: External Effects Need Their Own Receipts
sections.heading_zh: 外部效果需要自己的回执

evidenceClaims.claim: The reported architecture stores session truth in an append-only transcript outside its peer processes and rebuilds model-visible history as a projection.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 报告架构把会话事实存入对等进程之外的只追加记录，并把模型可见历史重建为该记录的投影。

evidenceClaims.claim: The protocol records represented completion durably before announcing downstream visibility.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 协议在向下游宣布可见前，先持久记录被表示的完成。

evidenceClaims.claim: Control delivery is at least once; stable global call identifiers and idempotent pairing handle duplicates.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 控制消息采用至少一次交付；重复由稳定全局调用标识与幂等配对处理。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study reports 12/12 session recoveries, 80/80 selected crash-point trials without repeating represented settled effects, and zero pairing-invariant violations in 3,500 calls.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告 12/12 个会话恢复、80/80 次选定崩溃点试验未重复被表示的已结算效果，以及 3500 次调用中的配对不变量违规数为 0。

evidenceClaims.claim: One reported fault path recomputes six interim results and remains materially slower, showing that effect suppression does not eliminate repeated work.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一个报告故障路径重新计算六个中间结果且明显更慢，说明效果抑制并不消除重复工作。

evidenceClaims.claim: Arbitrary external effects and multi-machine partition semantics are outside the study’s strongest demonstrated guarantee.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 任意外部效果与多机网络分区语义不在该研究最强证明范围内。

evidenceClaims.claim: Fault isolation and replay authority are separate properties because replay decisions require evidence outside the failed process.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 故障隔离与重放权威是不同性质，因为重放决定需要失败进程之外的证据。

projectRelevance.rationale: The recovery boundary is general to plugin and worker architectures.

communityEdition.rationale: A separate community edition would duplicate the same failure boundary and evidence without a distinct professional discussion problem.
